title: Khazad-dûm goes dark
description: Tremors from the burning mountain collapse the sun-shafts that light and feed Khazad-dûm. Disa's singers can no longer hear the rock, and father and son still will not speak to each other.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: Nenya's warning
description: Her ring shows Galadriel a vision of Celebrimbor dying. She begs to ride for Eregion; Gil-galad consents only if Elrond commands the company, and Círdan talks the reluctant Elrond into it.

title: The Dark Wizard
description: In his fortress of Caras Gaer a Dark Wizard learns that the Istar has come to Rhûn, and sends his masked riders to bring him in.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com

title: The sandstorm
description: Cornered at a well by the riders, the Stranger grabs a dead branch for a staff and raises a whirlwind. It scatters the hunters — and carries Nori and Poppy away with them.

title: The Lord of Gifts
description: Halbrand waits at the gates of Eregion until Celebrimbor, though warned never to see him again, lets him in. In the forge he walks into the flames and out again as Annatar, 'Lord of Gifts', a messenger of the Valar — and proposes rings for Dwarves and for Men.

image.credit: The Rings of Power © Amazon Studios, via lotr.fandom.com
